items.name: United States Congress
items.mission: Federal legislative institution composed of the House of Representatives and Senate; exercises powers assigned under Article I.

items.name: United States House of Representatives
items.mission: Population-apportioned chamber of Congress that legislates, initiates revenue measures, and exercises the sole power of impeachment.

items.name: United States Senate
items.mission: State-representative chamber of Congress that legislates, advises and consents on specified appointments and treaties, and tries impeachments.

items.name: Congressional Budget Office
items.mission: Provides Congress with objective, nonpartisan budgetary and economic analysis and cost estimates, without making policy recommendations.

items.name: Government Accountability Office
items.mission: Provides independent, nonpartisan audits, evaluations, and legal analysis to support congressional oversight and government accountability.

items.name: Library of Congress
items.mission: Preserves and provides knowledge and research resources for Congress and the public and administers key library and copyright functions.

items.name: Congressional Research Service
items.mission: Provides confidential, objective research, information and policy analysis to Congress to support legislation, representation, and oversight.

items.name: Government Publishing Office
items.mission: Produces, preserves, authenticates and distributes official federal government publications and information for public access.

items.name: Architect of the Capitol
items.mission: Maintains, operates, and preserves the Capitol campus and supports Congress, the Supreme Court, and visitors.
